card.name: End of table column headers
card.fires_on: The last word of a column header in a flattened dosing table, usually the closing parenthesis after a unit such as (kg) or (mg). It comes just before the first row of values or the next header.

modes.label: Unit bracket closes header
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a unit in a table header like Weight (kg) or Range (mg).
modes.example: Table 1. Dosing Recommendations for LAMIVUDINE Scored (150-mg) Tablets in Pediatric Patients Weight (kg<<)>> Twice-daily Dosing Regimen Using

modes.label: Last word of a header
modes.description: A header word or start of the next header where a table's column titles run together.
modes.example: Concomitant Drug Name<< Effect>> of Paroxetine on Other Drugs Clinical Recommendations

card.plain: It marks the spot where a dosing table's column titles end and the numbers begin.
